title: Declare honest Vercel catalogue coverage without ingest sources
objective: Expose Vercel across all fourteen canonical catalogue categories using current official provenance while producing no candidates, offers, or unsupported Z0 claims until generic same-document extraction exists.
out_of_scope_zero_diff: candidates, offers, quotas, or synthetic source rows
promotion or merge of the draft pull request
acceptance_criteria: A1: ProviderConfig accepts an explicitly present empty sources list while an omitted sources field remains invalid; existing nonempty provider configs load unchanged.

A2: coverage source references remain exact and fail actionably when sources is empty, evidence_url provenance satisfies the unchanged Q9-A floor, and no verified_free state is present in the Vercel config.

A3: vercel.example.yaml contains explicit sources: [], no service_categories or extraction profile, exactly fourteen unique canonical category slugs, and the approved state map of ten offered_no_z0, three not_offered, and one unknown.

A4: every Vercel declaration uses the approved current official canonical URL and precise rationale/comments disclose the category-boundary ambiguities, dependencies, analytics pause caveat, rejected notification taxonomy fit, unresolved application identity fit, and absence of no-card proof.
A5: sync_provider on PostgreSQL persists one Vercel Provider, zero Vercel Source rows, and fourteen coverage rows; a repeated sync is idempotent and creates no ingest/publication graph.

A6: source sync remains additive/upsert-only: a pre-existing stale source is retained rather than silently deleted, but run_provider_scans selects only source slugs declared by the current config, so a zero-source config executes zero scans and creates no ScanRun, Snapshot, Candidate, Evidence, Offer, OfferVersion, Quota, ChangeEvent, DiscoveryCandidate, or ReviewItem rows.
A7: CLI formatting explicitly reports the successful zero-configured-source outcome and returns success without a fabricated rejected candidate or review.
A8: the read API category matrix exposes all fourteen Vercel declarations with the exact state, rationale, and evidence_url, derived_state unknown, zero published offers, and no offer records.
A9: no migration, provider source row, adapter/profile, fixture, service mapping, temporary promotion, generic changelog, dependency, workflow, or feature-ledger change is introduced.

A10: mutation controls prove min_length=1 rejects Vercel, provenance removal breaks validation, adding a source/profile breaks no-source invariants, removing the current-config runner filter scans a retained stale source, and suppressing declaration serialization breaks the zero-offer read response.
verification_plan: Run focused config, runner, config-sync, and read-API tests against isolated PostgreSQL 16.
Run the CLI against the Vercel config and inspect both output and database row counts.
Run the full real-PostgreSQL pytest suite and require exactly the two expected stack-health skips.
Run scripts/check.ps1 -NodeAudit and require all Python, formatting, lint, secret, and dependency checks to pass.
Run external mutations A-E and restore each mutation before continuing.
Commission a fresh Level-2 evaluator to inspect database state, CLI behavior, read API output, exact URLs/rationales, and scope boundaries.
Push the focused commit, open a draft pull request, and leave F008 passes false.
mutation_plan: M-A: restore sources Field(min_length=1); the shipped Vercel config validation must fail.
M-B: remove an offered_no_z0 evidence_url or reduce evidence-backed declarations below three; config validation must fail.
M-C: add a source or extraction_profile to Vercel; the no-source config invariant must fail.
M-D: remove the runner filter to current config source slugs; the stale-source integration regression must produce a scan/error and fail.
M-E: omit declarations from the zero-offer category matrix response; the read-API integration assertion must fail.
data_implications: No migration. The existing provider, source, and coverage tables already support one Provider with zero Source rows and fourteen evidence_url-backed coverage declarations. Existing source sync is additive and does not prune removed rows; this slice documents and tests that behavior while preventing stale rows from being scanned for a zero-source config.
security_privacy: No secrets, credentials, network calls, user-controlled URLs, authentication, or authorization changes. Unit tests assert URL strings only; live URL verification belongs to the evaluator.
portability: No dependency or runtime change. PostgreSQL 16 is used for integration validation; zero-source control flow is database-portable SQLAlchemy behavior.
z0_risk: High product-truth sensitivity but fail-closed output: all existing Vercel categories are offered_no_z0 because no-card proof is absent; no candidate or offer can be produced by this slice.
known_boundary: Full Vercel P2 remains incomplete and blocked on generic same-document prose/matrix composition. Cross-document composition is explicitly forbidden.
